notes.name: TGP, the targeting pod as the SMS lists it (inferred); player_weapons.gd takes a store named TGP (or the 1998 game's FLIR) as the targeting pod
notes.kind: the targeting pod: the TGP format, the laser for the laser bombs (docs/mfd.md §9.9); the F-16I's Litening C4 (w-litening), the Sufa's Litening II as sufa-at names it
notes.drag: carriage drag index (flight-model.md §9.18): 0.15 x its 0.406 m across (w-litening) frontal area, 0.15 the drag of a streamlined pod on its pylon on that area (inferred, as the tanks')
notes.model: our Litening (shared/extra/models/stores/litening.glb: FlightGear's AN/AAQ-28 Litening AT at the real 2.20 m by 0.406 m, w-litening)
notes.generation: ours: the weapons.ibx section key (generation · 1000 + type) is one per weapon of a kind (the tanks hold 0 and 1)
notes.gives: the laser designator the laser bombs need (modern-iaf/docs/weapons.md §7.1)
notes.station: the chin hardpoint (twz-litening: the pod on the F-16's chin station); the sim's station 5 (sim.rs F16_SIM_STATIONS StationE)
